一人称と呼ばれ方のこと（僕・私・さん付け・通称名）: Japanese first-person words, names, and forms of address
だれでも使える、ていねいな一人称。フォーマルな場面の定番。: A polite first-person pronoun used by people of any gender. It is standard in formal settings.
やわらかい響き。「あたし」はより親しい・くだけた感じ。: Both have a soft tone. Atashi feels more intimate and casual.
やわらかめの自称。年齢や場面を問わず使う人がいます。: A gentle-sounding first-person pronoun. People use it across different ages and settings.
くだけた、力の入った響き。仲のよい間柄で。: A casual, assertive first-person pronoun often used with close friends.
関西などでよく使われる、性別を感じさせにくい自称。: A first-person pronoun common in Kansai and some other regions. It often carries little gendered meaning.
性別を出しにくい一人称。スポーツや職場でも。: A first-person pronoun that often carries little gendered meaning. It is common in sports and workplaces.
「〇〇はね」と自分の名前を一人称にする人もいます。: Some people use their own name in place of a first-person pronoun, as in “〇〇 wa ne.”
